copper-reach.source_kind: Original editorial composition; no old melody retained.
copper-reach.explore: Instrumental electronic science fiction strategy game soundtrack in the musical world of Ben Prunty FTL and FTL Multiverse. Warm rounded analog lead, rippling FM plucks, a deep melodic synth bass and drifting string-synth pads; curious, wistful frontier travel. An evolving melodic instrumental with arpeggiated inner motion, subtle harmonic colour and clear phrasing. Exploration arrangement: spacious, reflective and curious. Soft detailed electronic percussion, a gently moving bass and delicate repeating synthesizer patterns support the expressive lead. The middle passage opens into lighter suspended textures before the developed theme returns. Intimate game underscore with room between phrases. Steady tempo throughout; the quiet bass pulse and small percussion stay precisely on the beat through the thinner passage, return and ending.
copper-reach.battle: Driving instrumental electronic space battle game soundtrack, inspired by FTL and FTL Multiverse. A firm syncopated electronic drum groove, active deep synth bass, crisp snare and hi-hats, small tom fills and layered answering arpeggios. Urgent, tense and focused. Warm rounded analog lead, rippling FM plucks, a deep melodic synth bass and drifting string-synth pads; curious, wistful frontier travel. Build the full rhythmic arrangement through the first theme, thin it in the middle while keeping the pulse audible, then return with richer counterpoint and stronger drums. A tactical space battle.
